lines: 耶稣回答说：「你们去，
把所看见所听见的事告诉约翰，
就是瞎子看见，瘸子行走，
长大痲疯的洁净，聋子听见，
死人复活，穷人有福音传给他们。
耶穌回答說：「你們去，
把所看見所聽見的事告訴約翰，
就是瞎子看見，瘸子行走，
長大痲瘋的潔淨，聾子聽見，
死人復活，窮人有福音傳給他們。
Jesus answered them
“Go and tell John the things which you have seen and heard: that the blind receive their sight
the lame walk
the lepers are cleansed
the deaf hear
the dead are raised up
and the poor have good news preached to them.

And answering them he said
Go back and give news to John of what you have seen
and the things which have come to your ears; the blind now see
those who had no power in their legs are walking
lepers are made clean
those who had no hearing now have their ears open
dead men come to life again
and the poor have the good news given to them.

彼此说：「这到底是谁？他吩咐风和水，
连风和水也听从他了。」
耶穌對他們說：「你們的信心在那裏呢？」他們又懼怕又希奇，
彼此說：「這到底是誰？他吩咐風和水，
連風和水也聽從他了。」
He said to them

“Who is this then
that he commands even the winds and the water
and they obey him?”
